newsitem.title: USA: Putnam Investments to merge two closed-end funds.
newsitem.headline: Putnam Investments to merge two closed-end funds.

text.p: Putnam Investments on Friday said its trustees approved a merger of Putnam Intermediate Government Income Trust with Putnam Master Intermediate Income Trust.

The investment firm said it also planned to recommend that shareholders of Intermediate Government, Master Intermediate, Putnam Premier Income Trust and Putnam Master Income Trust vote to retain the funds' closed-end status at shareholder meetings to be held this year.
The merger is to be structured as a sale of assets in which Intermediate Government will transfer its assets to Master Intermediate in return for shares of Master Intermediate.
